title: Service Call Fees and Tenant Requests by Rental Tier
content:
Service-side figures of Rental Property Service Contracts, per tier. The service call fee is charged per service request and billed to the landlord; the after-hours surcharge applies when a non-emergency after-hours visit is requested; the second-opinion fee rate is the fraction of the service call fee charged for a second opinion the landlord requests; the repair guarantee is the number of calendar days after a completed repair during which a recall for the same failure carries no fee.

| Tier | Service call fee | After-hours surcharge | Second-opinion fee rate | Authorized tenant may place requests | Repair guarantee, calendar days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | $125.00 | $75.00 | 1.00 | yes | 30 |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | $125.00 | $75.00 | 1.00 | yes | 30 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | $125.00 | $75.00 | 1.00 | yes | 30 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | $100.00 | $75.00 | 0.00 | yes | 60 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | $125.00 | $75.00 | 1.00 | yes | 30 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | $100.00 | $75.00 | 0.00 | yes | 60 |

## Points of reading

- A second-opinion fee rate of 1.00 means the second opinion is charged at the full service call fee: $125.00 on the tiers that carry it.
- A second-opinion fee rate of 0.00 (the two Plus tiers) means a second opinion carries no fee.
- On every tier the landlord's authorized tenant contact may place service requests directly.
- The two Plus tiers carry the longer repair guarantee: 60 calendar days against 30 on the other four tiers.
